'''Raphael Asselin Original and Creative''' is a [[Dark]] deck by [[Raphael Asselin]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ds132.htm Original and Creative], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]).
